data.text:
KALAYAAN LGU SEEKS TO REMOVE MARCOLETA’S ‘GIVE UP’ REMARKS FROM RECORD

UPDATE: The Sangguniang Bayan of Kalayaan, Palawan has passed a resolution expressing “vigorous indignation and formal protest” over remarks suggesting the Philippines should “give up” the Kalayaan Island Group (KIG). 

The municipal council is urging the Commission on Appointments to expunge the supposed “defeatist sentiments” from the congressional records.

In Resolution No. 099-016 (2026), the council said such statements betray residents of Kalayaan and undermine Philippine sovereignty in the West Philippine Sea. 

It stressed that “not one inch” of the municipality is negotiable and warned that leaving the remarks on record implies consent to the country’s “own disappearance.”  @newswatchplusph
